## About

I am a third-year undergraduate student at the University of Waterloo, majoring in Psychology with a minor in Addictions, Mental Health and Policy.

## Research Interests

I am interested in cogntive psychology and cognitive neuroscience. I am currently a research assistant in the Face Processing & Social Cognition Lab, where I help run an EEG study on the effects of facial expression intensity on neural responses.
